definitions.gloss: middle-aged and older people; the middle-aged and elderly
definitions.explanation: A collective term for people in their middle years and beyond, typically from around 40 to 65 years old. Combines the concepts of middle age and older age into one demographic category.

examples.japanese: {中高年|ちゅうこうねん}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦{講座|こうざ}→講座：09790_kouza⟧。
examples.english: A health course aimed at middle-aged and older people.

examples.japanese: {中高年|ちゅうこうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Changing jobs is not easy for middle-aged and older workers.

examples.japanese: {中高年|ちゅうこうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{生活|せいかつ}{習慣病|しゅうかんびょう}→生活習慣病：08620_seikatsushuukanbyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まる→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: As you reach middle and older age, the risk of lifestyle diseases increases.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{中年|ちゅうねん}→中年：11307_chuunen⟧ (middle age) and {高年|こうねん} (older age), abbreviated to {中高年|ちゅうこうねん}. Widely used in media, government, and business contexts to refer to the demographic roughly between 40 and 65.

USAGE:
Very common as a modifier: {中高年|ちゅうこうねん}{向|む}け (aimed at middle-aged and older people), {中高年|ちゅうこうねん}⟦{層|そう}→層：12441_sou⟧ (the middle-aged and older demographic). Frequently appears in discussions of health, employment, and social policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中高年|ちゅうこうねん}{向|む}け — aimed at middle-aged and older people
- {中高年|ちゅうこうねん}⟦{層|そう}→層：12441_sou⟧ — middle-aged and older demographic
- {中高年|ちゅうこうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ — health of middle-aged and older people
- {中高年|ちゅうこうねん}⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧ — middle-aged and older men

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中年|ちゅうねん}→中年：11307_chuunen⟧ — middle age (roughly 40-55)
- ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧ — elderly person (65 and older)
- ⟦{壮年|そうねん}→壮年：19755_sounen⟧ — prime of life (roughly 30-50)
